title: ReVision: Selective Intrinsic Reasoning for Tool-Augmented, Reasoning-Intensive VQA
abstract: arXiv:2611.18637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: External tools substantially expand what multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can retrieve and compute on reasoning-intensive visual questions, and aggregate accuracy typically improves when tools are available. Our empirical study across six VQA benchmarks shows that aggregate accuracy gains under tool access can coexist with answer reversals: questions answered correctly without tools but incorrectly with tools. Trajectory analysis reveals substantially shorter reasoning turns under tool access, suggesting a shift from intrinsic visual reasoning toward reliance on external outputs. We propose ReVision, a training-free test-time method that registers intrinsic reconsideration as an optional action alongside search and code execution. When invoked, a separate tool-free multimodal call re-examines the original image, integrates accumulated evidence, and returns a revised analysis. translated_title: ReVision：面向工具增强、推理密集型视觉问答的选择性内在推理方法
translated_abstract: 外部工具大幅扩展了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在推理密集型视觉问题上可检索与计算的内容，且当工具可用时总体准确率通常会有所提升。我们在六个VQA基准上的实证研究表明，工具访问带来的总体准确率提升可能与“答案反转”现象共存：即某些问题在无工具时回答正确，但在有工具时反而回答错误。轨迹分析显示，工具访问下的推理轮次显著缩短，这表明模型从内在视觉推理转向了对外部输出的依赖。我们提出ReVision，一种无需训练的测试时方法，它将“内在重新审视”注册为与搜索和代码执行并列的可选动作。当该动作被调用时，一次独立的、不使用工具的多模态调用会重新审视原始图像，整合已累积的证据，并返回修订后的分析结果。MLLM自主决定是否以及何时使用该动作，无需固定的调度机制。
tldr: 该论文提出ReVision——一种无需训练的测试时方法，将“内在重新审视”作为与搜索、代码执行并列的可选动作，让模型在工具增强的推理密集型视觉问答中自主决定何时重新审视原始图像，从而缓解过度依赖外部工具导致的答案反转问题。
en_tdlr: ReVision is a training-free test-time method that registers intrinsic reconsideration as an optional action alongside search and code execution, enabling MLLMs to selectively re-examine the original image during tool-augmented, reasoning-intensive VQA to mitigate answer reversals caused by over-reliance on external tools.
